name: Gemini Campus Club @ Georgia Tech
tagline: Hands-on workshops for using Gemini across the tools you already live in.
mission: We're the Gemini Campus Club at Georgia Tech, backed by Google and run by GT's Google Student Ambassadors. We host hands-on workshops and events that show students how to use Gemini, Gemini Notebook, and Gemini's integrations across Google Workspace for real student work: studying, research, projects, clubs, and recruiting.
membership: Membership is free and open to every Georgia Tech student, whatever your major or year. You don't need any coding experience, just a laptop and a Google account. Find all our links on Linktree and follow @geminiatgt on Instagram for event updates.

integrations.useCase: Summarize a 40-email group-project thread and draft a reply that assigns next steps.
Turn messy lab notes into a structured report outline, then tighten the prose.
Build a club budget tracker and ask for formulas in plain English.
Generate a first-draft pitch deck and on-brand images for a hackathon demo.
Ask questions across every file in a project folder without opening any of them.
Plan an exam week around classes, meetings, and study blocks.
Get auto-generated notes and action items from team meetings.
Load lecture slides and readings, then generate study guides, quizzes, and Audio Overviews.
Prototype an app with the Gemini API in an afternoon, no setup required.
Get code explained, debugged, and extended inside your data-science notebooks.

faq.q: Do I need to know how to code?
faq.a: Nope. Most workshops use Gemini inside Google apps you already use. Build nights are the only coding-focused events, and beginners are welcome there too.
A laptop and a Google account. Some features need Google AI Pro, which eligible students can get free for a year at gemini.google/students. We'll help you set it up.
Gigi is our club's mascot, and Gemini's mascot too! Gigi also answers questions in the chat on this site.
Nothing. Membership and every event are free.
We're planning roughly every two weeks during the semester. Dates are coming soon; follow @geminiatgt on Instagram for announcements.

faq.q: Can my org partner with you?
faq.a: Yes! We already collaborate with Product@GT and AI@GT, and we're actively exploring more. Email us at geminicampusclub.gt@gmail.com.
Possibly! We're exploring hosting hackathons in the future. Follow @geminiatgt on Instagram to hear first.
